summary: refactor(settings): use auth-client in reset password containers
description:
Because:

- The ResetPassword pages loaded the Settings Account model through useAccount, which authentication pages should not do.

This commit:

- Calls auth-client directly in the three reset password containers.
- Moves the reset logic from Account into the containers and removes the four unused Account methods.
- Adds container tests, including the v2 key-stretch reset branch.

Closes FXA-9672
